nodes.label: Downloading songs (help article)
nodes.rationale: Download works for this computer's songs and for other computers' songs, as long as GLUE Home runs on the computer that has them. A song that cannot be fetched is left out; the panel lists what is missing and why.

nodes.label: Songs left out, listed with the reason
nodes.rationale: Songs with no file linked are listed too, so the user checks before a gig.
